messages.subject: calculateDiffMeth Errors
parts:
Hi,

I keep getting the following error when i try to calculate DMR between my samples.

myDiff=calculateDiffMeth(meth)
Error in lo:hi : NA/NaN argument

Has anyone come across this before and know if there is a way to stop this? Also, should i be concerned that I'm getting this error, as no one else appears to have posted on it before?

Best,

Claire

messages.subject: Re: [methylkit_discussion] calculateDiffMeth Errors
parts:
There may be something wrong with your "meth" methylBase object. Are
there NA values in it? You can have a look at object to check if there
is something wrong with it.

Best,
Altuna
